title: Think & Build Rich
subtitle: Chapter-by-chapter walk through Think and Grow Rich for modern builders.

lessons.title: Desire — The Starting Point of All Achievement
lessons.description: Chapter 2 in context. The difference between wishing and burning desire — and what it looks like for a builder.

lessons.title: Faith — Visualization of Belief
lessons.description: Self-confidence, autosuggestion, and programming your subconscious toward your goal.

lessons.title: Autosuggestion — Self-Programming
lessons.description: The technique Hill teaches — why it feels weird, why it works, and how to adapt it without the fluff.

lessons.title: Specialized Knowledge
lessons.description: Hill's argument for deep expertise over general knowledge — a direct challenge to 'learn everything' culture.

lessons.title: Imagination — The Workshop of the Mind
lessons.description: Synthetic vs creative imagination. How builders use both to design products and solve problems.

lessons.title: Organized Planning
lessons.description: The Mastermind in action. Building a plan that survives first contact with reality.

lessons.title: Decision — The Mastery of Procrastination
lessons.description: How successful people decide. The connection between decisiveness and building momentum.

lessons.title: Persistence — The Sustained Effort
lessons.description: Hill's four steps to persistence — applied to shipping, studying, and staying consistent.

lessons.title: The Mastermind Alliance
lessons.description: Two or more minds working in perfect harmony. How to find and build yours as a modern tech builder.

lessons.title: The Mystery of Sex Transmutation
lessons.description: Hill's most misunderstood chapter — redirecting creative energy into productive output, no mysticism.

lessons.title: The Subconscious Mind
lessons.description: What goes in shapes what comes out. Programming inputs consciously.

lessons.title: The Brain as a Broadcasting Station
lessons.description: Hill's intuition chapter interpreted through modern neuroscience and pattern recognition.

lessons.title: The Sixth Sense
lessons.description: Gut feeling as trained pattern recognition. What 'creative imagination' really means for a builder.

lessons.title: The Six Ghosts of Fear
lessons.description: Poverty, criticism, ill health, loss of love, old age, death — the fears that quietly sabotage builders.
